name: Simple Interest
expr: SI = P × R × T / 100

name: Compound Interest
expr: CI = P(1 + r)^n − P

name: Future Value (Lump Sum)
expr: FV = PV × (1 + r)^n

name: Present Value (Lump Sum)
expr: PV = FV / (1 + r)^n

name: Present Value of Annuity
expr: PVA = PMT × [1 − (1 + r)^−n] / r

name: Present Value of Perpetuity
expr: PV = PMT / r

name: Present Value of Growing Perpetuity
expr: PV = PMT / (r − g)

name: Effective Annual Rate
expr: EAR = (1 + i/m)^m − 1

name: Nominal vs Effective Rate
expr: concept: nominal rate is the stated annual rate; effective rate accounts for compounding frequency

name: Continuous Compounding
expr: FV = PV × e^(rt)

name: Rule of 72
expr: Years to Double ≈ 72 / Interest Rate (%)

name: Sinking Fund Deposit
expr: SFD = FV × r / [(1+r)^n − 1]

name: Compounding Frequency Adjustment
expr: r(periodic) = r(annual) / m

name: Current Ratio
expr: Current Ratio = Current Assets / Current Liabilities

name: Quick Ratio (Acid-Test)
expr: Quick Ratio = (Current Assets − Inventory) / Current Liabilities

name: Cash Ratio
expr: Cash Ratio = (Cash + Cash Equivalents) / Current Liabilities

name: Net Working Capital
expr: NWC = Current Assets − Current Liabilities

name: Working Capital Ratio
expr: WC Ratio = Working Capital / Total Assets

name: Defensive Interval Ratio
expr: DIR = (Cash + Marketable Securities + Receivables) / Daily Operating Expenses

name: Debt Ratio
expr: Debt Ratio = Total Debt / Total Assets

name: Debt to Equity Ratio
expr: D/E Ratio = Total Debt / Total Equity

name: Equity Ratio
expr: Equity Ratio = Total Equity / Total Assets

name: Interest Coverage Ratio
expr: ICR = EBIT / Interest Expense

name: Debt Service Coverage Ratio
expr: DSCR = Net Operating Income / Total Debt Service

name: Capital Gearing Ratio
expr: Gearing Ratio = Fixed-Interest Bearing Capital / Equity Shareholders' Funds

name: Long-term Debt to Capitalization
expr: LTD/Cap = Long-term Debt / (Long-term Debt + Equity)

name: Fixed Assets to Net Worth Ratio
expr: FA/NW = Fixed Assets / Net Worth

name: Proprietary Ratio
expr: Proprietary Ratio = Shareholders' Funds / Total Assets

name: Gross Profit Margin
expr: GPM = (Gross Profit / Net Sales) × 100

name: Net Profit Margin
expr: NPM = (Net Profit / Net Sales) × 100

name: Operating Profit Margin
expr: OPM = (Operating Profit / Net Sales) × 100

name: Return on Assets
expr: ROA = Net Income / Total Assets

name: Return on Equity
expr: ROE = Net Income / Shareholders' Equity

name: Return on Capital Employed
expr: ROCE = EBIT / Capital Employed

name: Return on Investment
expr: ROI = (Net Profit / Investment) × 100

name: Earnings Per Share
expr: EPS = (Net Income − Preferred Dividends) / Weighted Average Shares Outstanding

name: Price to Earnings Ratio
expr: P/E Ratio = Market Price per Share / EPS

name: Dividend Payout Ratio
expr: DPR = Dividends per Share / EPS

name: Dividend Yield
expr: Dividend Yield = Dividend per Share / Market Price per Share

name: Book Value per Share
expr: BVPS = Shareholders' Equity / Number of Shares Outstanding

name: Market to Book Ratio
expr: M/B Ratio = Market Price per Share / Book Value per Share

name: Operating Expense Ratio
expr: OER = Operating Expenses / Net Sales

name: Inventory Turnover Ratio
expr: Inventory Turnover = Cost of Goods Sold / Average Inventory

name: Days Inventory Outstanding
expr: DIO = 365 / Inventory Turnover Ratio

name: Receivables (Debtors) Turnover Ratio
expr: Receivables Turnover = Net Credit Sales / Average Accounts Receivable

name: Days Sales Outstanding
expr: DSO = 365 / Receivables Turnover Ratio

name: Payables (Creditors) Turnover Ratio
expr: Payables Turnover = Net Credit Purchases / Average Accounts Payable

name: Days Payable Outstanding
expr: DPO = 365 / Payables Turnover Ratio

name: Total Asset Turnover Ratio
expr: Asset Turnover = Net Sales / Average Total Assets

name: Fixed Asset Turnover Ratio
expr: Fixed Asset Turnover = Net Sales / Average Fixed Assets

name: Working Capital Turnover Ratio
expr: WC Turnover = Net Sales / Average Working Capital

name: Cash Conversion Cycle
expr: CCC = DIO + DSO − DPO

name: Operating Cycle
expr: Operating Cycle = DIO + DSO

name: Net Present Value
expr: NPV = Σ [CFt / (1+r)^t] − Initial Investment

name: Internal Rate of Return
expr: concept: discount rate at which NPV of a project equals zero

name: Payback Period
expr: PP = Initial Investment / Annual Cash Inflow

name: Discounted Payback Period
expr: concept: payback period computed using discounted cash flows instead of nominal cash flows

name: Accounting (Average) Rate of Return
expr: ARR = Average Annual Profit / Average Investment × 100

name: Profitability Index
expr: PI = PV of Future Cash Flows / Initial Investment

name: Modified Internal Rate of Return
expr: MIRR = [(FV of Positive Cash Flows / PV of Negative Cash Flows)]^(1/n) − 1

name: Capital Rationing
expr: concept: allocating limited capital among competing investment projects to maximize total NPV

name: Sensitivity Analysis (Capital Budgeting)
expr: concept: examining how NPV/IRR changes when a single input variable is changed

name: Scenario Analysis (Capital Budgeting)
expr: concept: evaluating project outcomes under best-case, worst-case, and base-case assumptions

name: Break-even Analysis (Capital Budgeting)
expr: concept: sales level at which a project's NPV equals zero

name: Replacement Chain Method
expr: concept: comparing mutually exclusive projects with unequal lives by extending them to a common time horizon

name: Terminal Cash Flow
expr: Terminal CF = Salvage Value − Tax on Sale + Recovery of Net Working Capital

name: Initial Outlay
expr: Initial Outlay = Cost of New Asset + Installation Costs − Salvage Value of Old Asset + Net Working Capital Change

name: Cost of Debt (Before-tax)
expr: Kd = Interest Payment / Net Proceeds of Debt

name: Cost of Debt (After-tax)
expr: Kd(after-tax) = Kd × (1 − Tax Rate)

name: Cost of Preferred Stock
expr: Kp = Preferred Dividend / Net Proceeds of Preferred Stock

name: Cost of Equity (Dividend Growth Model)
expr: Ke = (D1 / P0) + g

name: Cost of Equity (CAPM)
expr: Ke = Rf + β(Rm − Rf)

name: Cost of Retained Earnings
expr: Kr = Ke (approx, no flotation cost)

name: Weighted Average Cost of Capital
expr: WACC = (E/V)×Ke + (D/V)×Kd×(1−T) + (P/V)×Kp

name: Marginal Cost of Capital
expr: concept: cost of the next (additional) unit of capital raised by a firm

name: Flotation Cost Adjustment
expr: Ke(adjusted) = D1 / [P0 × (1 − f)] + g

name: Break Point in MCC Schedule
expr: Break Point = Amount of Capital at Given Cost Bracket / Weight of that Capital Source

name: Degree of Operating Leverage
expr: DOL = % Change in EBIT / % Change in Sales

name: Degree of Financial Leverage
expr: DFL = % Change in EPS / % Change in EBIT

name: Degree of Combined Leverage
expr: DCL = DOL × DFL

name: Operating Leverage Formula (Contribution basis)
expr: DOL = Contribution Margin / EBIT

name: Financial Leverage Formula (EBIT basis)
expr: DFL = EBIT / (EBIT − Interest)

name: Indifference Point (EBIT-EPS Analysis)
expr: concept: EBIT level at which EPS is the same under two different financing plans

name: Modigliani-Miller Proposition I (No Tax)
expr: concept: firm value is independent of its capital structure in a perfect market with no taxes

name: Modigliani-Miller Proposition II (No Tax)
expr: Ke = Ko + (Ko − Kd) × (D/E)

name: Modigliani-Miller with Taxes
expr: concept: firm value rises with leverage due to the tax shield on interest, VL = VU + T×D

name: Trade-off Theory of Capital Structure
expr: concept: optimal leverage balances the tax benefits of debt against the costs of financial distress

name: Pecking Order Theory
expr: concept: firms prefer internal financing first, then debt, and equity as a last resort

name: Financial Distress Cost
expr: concept: costs arising from a high probability of bankruptcy due to excessive leverage

name: Optimal Capital Structure
expr: concept: debt-equity mix that minimizes WACC and maximizes firm value

name: Gross Working Capital
expr: GWC = Total Current Assets

name: Net Working Capital (Finance)
expr: NWC = Current Assets − Current Liabilities

name: Working Capital Requirement
expr: WCR = Current Assets (excluding cash) − Current Liabilities (excluding short-term debt)

name: Reorder Point
expr: ROP = (Average Daily Usage × Lead Time) + Safety Stock

name: Safety Stock
expr: Safety Stock = (Max Daily Usage − Average Daily Usage) × Lead Time

name: Miller-Orr Cash Management Model
expr: Z = (3 × Transaction Cost × Variance of Cash Flows / (4 × Interest Rate))^(1/3)

name: Float (Cash Management)
expr: Float = Bank Balance − Book Balance

name: Net Credit Position
expr: concept: comparison of a firm's receivables outstanding against its payables outstanding

name: Dividend Payout Ratio (Finance)
expr: DPR = Total Dividends / Net Income

name: Retention Ratio
expr: Retention Ratio = 1 − Dividend Payout Ratio

name: Sustainable Growth Rate
expr: SGR = ROE × Retention Ratio

name: Gordon Growth Dividend Model
expr: P0 = D1 / (Ke − g)

name: Walter's Dividend Model
expr: P = [D + (Ra/Ke)(E − D)] / Ke

name: Modigliani-Miller Dividend Irrelevance
expr: concept: in a perfect market, dividend policy does not affect firm value

name: Bird-in-Hand Theory
expr: concept: investors prefer certain current dividends over uncertain future capital gains

name: Stock Split Effect
expr: concept: proportional increase in shares outstanding with a corresponding decrease in price per share, no change in firm value

name: Stock Dividend
expr: concept: distribution of additional shares to shareholders instead of cash

name: Bond Value (Price)
expr: B0 = Σ[Coupon / (1+r)^t] + Face Value / (1+r)^n

name: Yield to Maturity
expr: concept: discount rate that equates a bond's price to the present value of its cash flows

name: Current Yield
expr: Current Yield = Annual Coupon Payment / Market Price

name: Coupon Rate
expr: Coupon Rate = Annual Coupon Payment / Face Value

name: Zero-Coupon Bond Value
expr: B0 = Face Value / (1+r)^n

name: Bond Duration
expr: concept: weighted average time to receive a bond's cash flows, a measure of interest rate sensitivity

name: Modified Duration
expr: Modified Duration = Macaulay Duration / (1 + YTM/m)

name: Bond Convexity
expr: concept: measure of the curvature in the price-yield relationship of a bond

name: Premium Bond
expr: concept: bond trading above face value because coupon rate exceeds market interest rate

name: Discount Bond
expr: concept: bond trading below face value because coupon rate is below market interest rate

name: Dividend Discount Model (Zero Growth)
expr: P0 = D / Ke

name: Dividend Discount Model (Constant Growth)
expr: P0 = D1 / (Ke − g)

name: Price-Earnings Valuation
expr: P0 = EPS × P/E Ratio

name: Free Cash Flow to Equity
expr: FCFE = Net Income + Depreciation − Capital Expenditure − Change in Working Capital + Net Borrowing

name: Free Cash Flow to Firm
expr: FCFF = EBIT(1−T) + Depreciation − Capital Expenditure − Change in Working Capital

name: Enterprise Value
expr: EV = Market Capitalization + Total Debt − Cash and Cash Equivalents

name: EV/EBITDA Multiple
expr: EV/EBITDA = Enterprise Value / EBITDA

name: PEG Ratio
expr: PEG = (P/E Ratio) / Earnings Growth Rate

name: Residual Income Valuation
expr: RI = Net Income − (Equity Charge × Book Value of Equity)

name: Expected Return (Single Asset)
expr: E(R) = Σ [Probability × Return]

name: Variance of Returns
expr: Variance = Σ [Probability × (Return − Expected Return)²]

name: Standard Deviation of Returns
expr: σ = √Variance

name: Coefficient of Variation
expr: CV = Standard Deviation / Expected Return

name: Portfolio Expected Return
expr: E(Rp) = Σ (wi × E(Ri))

name: Portfolio Variance (Two Assets)
expr: σp² = w1²σ1² + w2²σ2² + 2w1w2Cov(1,2)

name: Beta Coefficient
expr: β = Cov(Ri, Rm) / Var(Rm)

name: Capital Asset Pricing Model
expr: E(Ri) = Rf + βi × (Rm − Rf)

name: Security Market Line
expr: concept: graphical representation of CAPM, showing expected return against systematic risk (beta)

name: Capital Market Line
expr: concept: line showing risk-return combinations of efficient portfolios combining the risk-free asset and market portfolio

name: Sharpe Ratio
expr: Sharpe Ratio = (Rp − Rf) / σp

name: Treynor Ratio
expr: Treynor Ratio = (Rp − Rf) / βp

name: Jensen's Alpha
expr: Alpha = Rp − [Rf + βp(Rm − Rf)]

name: Systematic Risk
expr: concept: market-wide risk that cannot be eliminated through diversification

name: Unsystematic Risk
expr: concept: firm-specific risk that can be reduced through diversification

name: Diversifiable vs Non-Diversifiable Risk
expr: Total Risk = Systematic Risk + Unsystematic Risk

name: Break-even Point (Units)
expr: BEP(units) = Fixed Costs / (Selling Price per Unit − Variable Cost per Unit)

name: Break-even Point (Sales Value)
expr: BEP(sales) = Fixed Costs / Contribution Margin Ratio

name: Contribution Margin per Unit
expr: CM = Selling Price − Variable Cost per Unit

name: Contribution Margin Ratio
expr: CM Ratio = Contribution Margin / Selling Price

name: Margin of Safety
expr: MOS = Actual Sales − Break-even Sales

name: Margin of Safety Ratio
expr: MOS Ratio = Margin of Safety / Actual Sales

name: Target Profit Sales Volume
expr: Target Sales = (Fixed Costs + Target Profit) / Contribution Margin per Unit

name: Operating Leverage (CVP)
expr: DOL = Contribution Margin / Operating Income

name: Common-Size Income Statement
expr: concept: each income statement item expressed as a percentage of net sales

name: Common-Size Balance Sheet
expr: concept: each balance sheet item expressed as a percentage of total assets

name: Horizontal Analysis
expr: % Change = [(Current Year − Base Year) / Base Year] × 100

name: Vertical Analysis
expr: concept: each financial statement line item expressed as a percentage of a base figure (e.g., total assets or sales)

name: DuPont Analysis (3-Step)
expr: ROE = Net Profit Margin × Asset Turnover × Equity Multiplier

name: Equity Multiplier
expr: Equity Multiplier = Total Assets / Total Equity

name: Altman Z-Score
expr: Z = 1.2X1 + 1.4X2 + 3.3X3 + 0.6X4 + 1.0X5 (bankruptcy prediction model)

name: Free Cash Flow
expr: FCF = Operating Cash Flow − Capital Expenditures

name: Cash Flow Coverage Ratio
expr: CFCR = (Operating Cash Flow + Lease Payments) / (Debt + Lease + Preferred Dividends)

name: Trade Credit Terms Cost
expr: Cost of Not Taking Discount = [Discount% / (100 − Discount%)] × [365 / (Net Period − Discount Period)]

name: Effective Cost of Bank Overdraft
expr: concept: interest cost adjusted for compensating balance requirements or commitment fees

name: Factoring Cost
expr: concept: cost of selling accounts receivable to a factor at a discount for immediate cash

name: Commercial Paper Cost
expr: concept: discount-based short-term unsecured borrowing cost for large, creditworthy firms

name: Letter of Credit (concept)
expr: concept: bank guarantee ensuring payment to a seller upon fulfillment of agreed trade terms

name: Spot Exchange Rate
expr: concept: current market price to exchange one currency for another for immediate delivery

name: Forward Exchange Rate
expr: concept: agreed exchange rate for a currency transaction to be settled at a future date

name: Covered Interest Arbitrage
expr: concept: earning a risk-free profit by exploiting deviations from interest rate parity using a forward contract

name: Translation Exposure
expr: concept: risk of change in reported financial results due to exchange rate movements when consolidating foreign subsidiaries

name: Transaction Exposure
expr: concept: risk from exchange rate changes affecting the value of committed foreign-currency cash flows

name: Economic Exposure
expr: concept: risk that exchange rate changes affect a firm's future cash flows and competitive position

name: Cross Exchange Rate
expr: Cross Rate = (Currency A/Currency B) × (Currency B/Currency C)

name: Exchange Ratio (M&A)
expr: Exchange Ratio = Offer Price per Share of Target / Market Price per Share of Acquirer

name: Synergy Value
expr: Synergy = Value of Combined Firm − (Value of Acquirer + Value of Target)

name: Accretion/Dilution Analysis
expr: concept: assessing whether a merger increases (accretive) or decreases (dilutive) the acquirer's EPS

name: Goodwill on Acquisition
expr: Goodwill = Purchase Price − Fair Value of Net Identifiable Assets

name: Leveraged Buyout (concept)
expr: concept: acquisition of a company financed largely with borrowed funds, using the target's assets as collateral

name: Free Cash Flow to Firm (M&A Valuation)
expr: concept: used to value the combined entity in a merger by discounting projected free cash flows

name: Call Option Payoff
expr: Payoff = Max(0, Spot Price − Strike Price)

name: Put Option Payoff
expr: Payoff = Max(0, Strike Price − Spot Price)

name: Intrinsic Value of an Option
expr: concept: the amount an option is in-the-money, ignoring time value

name: Time Value of an Option
expr: Time Value = Option Premium − Intrinsic Value

name: Put-Call Parity
expr: C − P = S0 − Ke^(−rT)

name: Forward Contract Payoff
expr: Payoff (Long) = Spot Price at Maturity − Forward Price

name: Futures Margin (Initial)
expr: concept: minimum deposit required to open a futures position

name: Hedging with Futures
expr: concept: using a futures position to offset price risk in an underlying asset

name: Murabaha Financing
expr: Selling Price = Cost Price + Disclosed Profit Margin

name: Mudarabah Profit Sharing (Finance)
expr: Profit Share = Agreed Ratio × Total Profit; loss borne only by the capital provider

name: Musharakah Financing
expr: Profit shared per agreed ratio; loss shared strictly according to capital contribution

name: Ijarah Rental Structure
expr: concept: financing structure where the financier retains asset ownership and earns rental income

name: Sukuk Valuation
expr: concept: value of Islamic bonds derived from the underlying tangible asset's cash flows, not interest

name: Diminishing Musharakah (Home Financing)
expr: concept: co-ownership arrangement where the customer gradually buys out the bank's share in the asset

name: Agency Cost
expr: concept: cost arising from conflicts of interest between shareholders and managers

name: Signaling Theory (Finance)
expr: concept: financial decisions (like dividends or debt issuance) convey information about a firm's prospects to the market

name: Percent-of-Sales Method (Financial Forecasting)
expr: concept: forecasting financial statement items as a percentage of projected sales

name: External Financing Needed
expr: EFN = Required Increase in Assets − Increase in Liabilities − Increase in Retained Earnings

name: Internal Growth Rate
expr: IGR = (ROA × Retention Ratio) / [1 − (ROA × Retention Ratio)]

name: Sustainable Growth Rate (Finance)
expr: SGR = (ROE × Retention Ratio) / [1 − (ROE × Retention Ratio)]

name: Budget Variance
expr: Variance = Actual Amount − Budgeted Amount

name: Zero-Based Budgeting
expr: concept: budgeting approach requiring every expense to be justified from a zero base each period

name: Capital Rationing (Finance)
expr: concept: choosing the combination of projects that maximizes NPV within a limited capital budget

name: Material Cost Variance
expr: MCV = Standard Cost of Actual Output − Actual Cost

name: Material Price Variance
expr: MPV = (Standard Price − Actual Price) × Actual Quantity

name: Material Usage Variance
expr: MUV = (Standard Quantity for Actual Output − Actual Quantity) × Standard Price

name: Material Mix Variance
expr: MMV = (Revised Standard Quantity − Actual Quantity) × Standard Price

name: Material Yield Variance
expr: MYV = (Actual Yield − Standard Yield) × Standard Cost per Unit

name: Labor Cost Variance
expr: LCV = Standard Cost of Actual Output − Actual Labor Cost

name: Labor Rate Variance
expr: LRV = (Standard Rate − Actual Rate) × Actual Hours

name: Labor Efficiency Variance
expr: LEV = (Standard Hours for Actual Output − Actual Hours) × Standard Rate

name: Labor Idle Time Variance
expr: LITV = Idle Hours × Standard Rate

name: Variable Overhead Cost Variance
expr: VOCV = Standard Variable Overhead − Actual Variable Overhead

name: Variable Overhead Spending Variance
expr: VOSV = (Standard Rate − Actual Rate) × Actual Hours

name: Variable Overhead Efficiency Variance
expr: VOEV = (Standard Hours − Actual Hours) × Standard Rate

name: Fixed Overhead Cost Variance
expr: FOCV = Absorbed Fixed Overhead − Actual Fixed Overhead

name: Fixed Overhead Volume Variance
expr: FOVV = (Actual Output − Budgeted Output) × Standard Fixed Overhead Rate

name: Fixed Overhead Expenditure Variance
expr: FOEV = Budgeted Fixed Overhead − Actual Fixed Overhead

name: Sales Value Variance
expr: SVV = Actual Sales Value − Standard/Budgeted Sales Value

name: Sales Price Variance
expr: SPV = (Actual Price − Standard Price) × Actual Quantity Sold

name: Sales Volume Variance
expr: SVoV = (Actual Quantity − Budgeted Quantity) × Standard Profit/Contribution per Unit

name: Total Cost Variance
expr: TCV = Standard Cost − Actual Cost

name: Flexible Budget Variance
expr: FBV = Actual Results − Flexible Budget Amount

name: Prime Cost
expr: Prime Cost = Direct Material + Direct Labor + Direct Expenses

name: Factory (Works) Cost
expr: Factory Cost = Prime Cost + Factory Overheads

name: Cost of Goods Manufactured
expr: COGM = Beginning WIP + Total Manufacturing Costs − Ending WIP

name: Cost of Goods Sold
expr: COGS = Beginning Inventory + Purchases − Ending Inventory

name: Predetermined Overhead Rate
expr: POR = Budgeted Overhead Costs / Budgeted Allocation Base

name: Applied Overhead
expr: Applied Overhead = Predetermined Overhead Rate × Actual Allocation Base

name: Under/Over-Applied Overhead
expr: Variance = Applied Overhead − Actual Overhead

name: Activity-Based Costing Rate
expr: ABC Rate = Total Cost of Activity Pool / Total Cost Driver Volume

name: Job Order Costing (concept)
expr: concept: costs are accumulated separately for each distinct job or batch of production

name: Process Costing (concept)
expr: concept: costs are accumulated by process/department and averaged over all units produced

name: Equivalent Units of Production
expr: EUP = Units Completed + (Units in Ending WIP × % Completion)

name: Cost per Equivalent Unit
expr: Cost per EU = Total Cost / Equivalent Units of Production

name: Marginal Costing (Variable Costing)
expr: concept: only variable production costs are included in product cost; fixed costs are treated as period costs

name: Absorption Costing
expr: concept: both variable and fixed manufacturing costs are included in product cost

name: Reconciliation of Marginal & Absorption Profit
expr: Profit Difference = Change in Inventory Units × Fixed Overhead Rate per Unit

name: Joint Cost Allocation (Physical Units Method)
expr: Allocated Cost = (Physical Units of Product / Total Physical Units) × Joint Cost

name: Joint Cost Allocation (Sales Value Method)
expr: Allocated Cost = (Sales Value of Product / Total Sales Value) × Joint Cost

name: By-product Costing (concept)
expr: concept: accounting treatment for minor products incidentally produced along with the main product

name: Premium Calculation (Life Insurance)
expr: concept: premium determined based on mortality tables, interest assumptions, and expenses

name: Sum Assured (concept)
expr: concept: the guaranteed amount payable by an insurer on death or maturity of a life insurance policy

name: Loss Ratio
expr: Loss Ratio = Incurred Losses / Earned Premiums

name: Combined Ratio (Insurance)
expr: Combined Ratio = Loss Ratio + Expense Ratio

name: Expected Loss
expr: Expected Loss = Probability of Loss × Amount of Loss

name: Actuarial Present Value
expr: concept: present value of a future contingent payment, weighted by the probability of the event occurring

name: Deductible (concept)
expr: concept: amount an insured must pay out of pocket before insurance coverage applies

name: Risk Pooling (concept)
expr: concept: spreading individual risk across a large group to reduce the impact of any single loss

name: Reinsurance (concept)
expr: concept: insurance purchased by an insurance company to transfer part of its risk to another insurer

name: Value at Risk
expr: VaR = Portfolio Value × Z-score × Standard Deviation × √Time

name: Retirement Corpus Needed
expr: Corpus = Annual Expenses × [1 − (1+r)^−n] / r

name: Savings Rate
expr: Savings Rate = (Income − Expenses) / Income × 100

name: Debt-to-Income Ratio
expr: DTI = Total Monthly Debt Payments / Gross Monthly Income

name: Emergency Fund Ratio
expr: EF Ratio = Liquid Assets / Monthly Essential Expenses

name: Net Worth
expr: Net Worth = Total Assets − Total Liabilities

name: Mortgage Affordability
expr: concept: maximum loan amount a borrower can service based on income and debt ratios

name: Loan-to-Value Ratio
expr: LTV = Loan Amount / Appraised Value of Asset

name: Capital Adequacy Ratio
expr: CAR = (Tier 1 Capital + Tier 2 Capital) / Risk-Weighted Assets

name: Non-Performing Loan Ratio
expr: NPL Ratio = Non-Performing Loans / Total Loans

name: Net Interest Margin
expr: NIM = (Interest Income − Interest Expense) / Average Earning Assets

name: Credit Score Impact (concept)
expr: concept: statistical model estimating a borrower's creditworthiness based on repayment history and financial behavior

name: Debt Service Coverage Ratio (Banking)
expr: DSCR = Net Operating Income / Total Debt Service

name: Cost-to-Income Ratio (Banking)
expr: Cost-to-Income = Operating Expenses / Operating Income

name: Cash Budget (concept)
expr: concept: forecast of a firm's cash inflows and outflows over a future period

name: Cash Conversion Efficiency
expr: CCE = Operating Cash Flow / Net Sales

name: Compensating Balance Requirement (concept)
expr: concept: minimum balance a bank requires a borrower to maintain as part of a loan agreement

name: Overconfidence Bias (Finance)
expr: concept: investors overestimate the accuracy of their own judgments and predictions

name: Herding Behavior (Finance)
expr: concept: investors follow the actions of a larger group rather than their own analysis

name: Loss Aversion (Finance)
expr: concept: investors feel the pain of losses more strongly than the pleasure of equivalent gains

name: Mental Accounting
expr: concept: individuals treat money differently depending on its source or intended use

name: Anchoring Bias (Finance)
expr: concept: investors rely too heavily on an initial reference point when making decisions

name: Disposition Effect
expr: concept: tendency of investors to sell winning investments too early and hold losing investments too long

name: Capitalization Rate
expr: Cap Rate = Net Operating Income / Property Value

name: Gross Rent Multiplier
expr: GRM = Property Price / Gross Annual Rental Income

name: Net Operating Income (Real Estate)
expr: NOI = Gross Rental Income − Operating Expenses

name: Debt Coverage Ratio (Real Estate)
expr: DCR = Net Operating Income / Annual Debt Service

name: Cash-on-Cash Return
expr: CoC Return = Annual Pre-tax Cash Flow / Total Cash Invested

name: Times Interest Earned Ratio
expr: TIE = EBIT / Interest Expense

name: Asset Coverage Ratio
expr: Asset Coverage = (Total Assets − Intangible Assets − Current Liabilities) / Total Debt

name: Operating Margin
expr: Operating Margin = Operating Income / Net Sales

name: EBITDA Margin
expr: EBITDA Margin = EBITDA / Net Sales

name: Cash Flow Margin
expr: Cash Flow Margin = Operating Cash Flow / Net Sales

name: Return on Sales
expr: ROS = Net Income / Net Sales

name: Return on Invested Capital
expr: ROIC = NOPAT / Invested Capital

name: Net Operating Profit After Tax
expr: NOPAT = EBIT × (1 − Tax Rate)

name: Economic Value Added
expr: EVA = NOPAT − (Invested Capital × WACC)

name: Market Value Added
expr: MVA = Market Value of Firm − Total Capital Invested

name: Tobin's Q
expr: Tobin's Q = Market Value of Firm / Replacement Cost of Assets

name: Interest Burden Ratio
expr: Interest Burden = EBT / EBIT

name: Tax Burden Ratio
expr: Tax Burden = Net Income / EBT

name: Terminal Value (Perpetuity Growth Method)
expr: TV = FCFn × (1+g) / (WACC − g)

name: Terminal Value (Exit Multiple Method)
expr: TV = Terminal Year EBITDA × Exit Multiple

name: Discounted Cash Flow Value
expr: DCF Value = Σ [FCFt / (1+WACC)^t] + [TV / (1+WACC)^n]

name: Comparable Company Analysis
expr: concept: valuing a firm using valuation multiples (P/E, EV/EBITDA) of similar publicly traded companies

name: Precedent Transaction Analysis
expr: concept: valuing a firm based on multiples observed in comparable past M&A transactions

name: Sum-of-the-Parts Valuation
expr: concept: valuing a company by separately valuing each business segment and adding them together

name: Liquidation Value
expr: Liquidation Value = Sum of Estimated Sale Values of Assets − Total Liabilities

name: Replacement Cost Valuation
expr: concept: valuing an asset based on the current cost of replacing it with a similar one

name: Black-Scholes Option Pricing Model
expr: concept: model for pricing European call/put options using volatility, time, and interest rate inputs

name: Delta (Option Greek)
expr: Delta = ∂(Option Price) / ∂(Underlying Price)

name: Gamma (Option Greek)
expr: Gamma = ∂(Delta) / ∂(Underlying Price)

name: Theta (Option Greek)
expr: Theta = ∂(Option Price) / ∂(Time)

name: Vega (Option Greek)
expr: Vega = ∂(Option Price) / ∂(Volatility)

name: Swap Rate (concept)
expr: concept: fixed rate exchanged for a floating rate in an interest rate swap agreement

name: Forward Rate Agreement (concept)
expr: concept: over-the-counter contract fixing the interest rate for a future borrowing/lending period

name: Macaulay Duration
expr: Macaulay Duration = Σ[t × PV(CFt)] / Bond Price

name: Bond Price Sensitivity (Approx)
expr: % Change in Price ≈ −Modified Duration × Change in Yield

name: Accrued Interest
expr: Accrued Interest = Coupon × (Days Since Last Payment / Days in Period)

name: Clean Price vs Dirty Price
expr: Dirty Price = Clean Price + Accrued Interest

name: Callable Bond Yield to Call
expr: concept: yield calculated assuming the bond is redeemed at the earliest call date

name: Takaful Contribution (concept)
expr: concept: amount contributed by participants to a mutual Takaful fund for risk-sharing

name: Wakalah Fee Structure (concept)
expr: concept: fee charged by an agent (Wakil) for managing funds or transactions on behalf of a client

name: Foreign Exchange Gain/Loss
expr: FX Gain/Loss = (Closing Rate − Opening Rate) × Foreign Currency Amount

name: Real Effective Exchange Rate
expr: concept: nominal exchange rate adjusted for relative price levels against a basket of trading-partner currencies

name: Balance of Payments Equilibrium (Finance)
expr: concept: current account balance plus capital account balance equals zero (in theory)

name: Country Risk Premium
expr: Country Risk Premium = Sovereign Bond Yield Spread over a benchmark risk-free rate

name: Foreign Currency Translation (Current Rate Method)
expr: concept: translating foreign subsidiary financials using the exchange rate at the balance sheet date

name: Control Premium
expr: Control Premium = (Offer Price − Pre-Announcement Market Price) / Pre-Announcement Market Price

name: Break-up Fee (concept)
expr: concept: fee paid by a target company to an acquirer if a merger agreement is terminated

name: Residual Dividend Policy
expr: Dividend = Net Income − (Equity Portion of Capital Budget)

name: Clientele Effect
expr: concept: different investor groups prefer different dividend policies based on their tax and income needs

name: Geometric Mean Return
expr: Geometric Mean = [(1+R1)(1+R2)...(1+Rn)]^(1/n) − 1

name: Arithmetic Mean Return
expr: Arithmetic Mean = (R1 + R2 + ... + Rn) / n

name: Holding Period Return
expr: HPR = (Ending Value − Beginning Value + Income) / Beginning Value

name: Annualized Return
expr: Annualized Return = (1 + HPR)^(365/Days Held) − 1

name: Real Rate of Return
expr: Real Return = [(1 + Nominal Return) / (1 + Inflation Rate)] − 1

name: Weighted Average Maturity
expr: WAM = Σ (Weight of Security × Maturity of Security)

name: Loan Balance After n Payments
expr: Balance = PMT × [1 − (1+r)^−(N−n)] / r

name: Compound Annual Growth Rate
expr: CAGR = (Ending Value / Beginning Value)^(1/n) − 1

name: Crossover Rate (NPV Profiles)
expr: concept: discount rate at which two projects' NPVs are equal

name: Fisher's Rate of Intersection
expr: concept: discount rate at which the NPVs of two mutually exclusive projects intersect

name: Real Options in Capital Budgeting
expr: concept: value of managerial flexibility to expand, delay, or abandon a project as new information arrives

name: Abandonment Value
expr: concept: value recovered if a project is terminated before the end of its planned life

name: Pure Play Method (Beta Estimation)
expr: concept: estimating a project's beta using comparable firms in the same line of business

name: Expected Value (Finance)
expr: E(X) = Σ [Probability × Outcome]

name: Skewness of Returns
expr: concept: measure of asymmetry in the distribution of investment returns

name: Kurtosis of Returns
expr: concept: measure of the 'tailedness' of the distribution of investment returns

name: Confidence Interval for Mean Return
expr: CI = Mean ± (Z-score × Standard Error)

name: Regression Beta Estimation
expr: β = Cov(Ri, Rm) / Var(Rm)

name: Initial Public Offering Pricing (concept)
expr: concept: process of determining the offer price of shares when a company first lists on a stock exchange

name: Underwriting Spread
expr: Underwriting Spread = Offer Price to Public − Price Paid to Issuer

name: Book Building Process (concept)
expr: concept: price discovery method where investors bid within a price band to determine the final issue price

name: Rights Issue Price
expr: concept: discounted price at which existing shareholders are offered new shares in proportion to holdings

name: Ex-Rights Price
expr: Ex-Rights Price = [(Shares Outstanding × Cum-Rights Price) + (New Shares × Subscription Price)] / Total Shares

name: Value of a Right
expr: Value of Right = (Cum-Rights Price − Subscription Price) / (N + 1)

name: Stock Market Index Return
expr: Index Return = [(Closing Index − Opening Index) / Opening Index] × 100

name: Market Capitalization
expr: Market Cap = Share Price × Number of Shares Outstanding

name: Free Float Market Capitalization
expr: Free Float Market Cap = Market Price × Freely Tradable Shares

name: Dividend Reinvestment Return
expr: concept: total return including the compounding effect of reinvested dividends

name: Exchange-Traded Fund Net Asset Value
expr: NAV = (Total Assets − Total Liabilities) / Number of Units Outstanding

name: Mutual Fund Expense Ratio
expr: Expense Ratio = Total Fund Operating Expenses / Average Net Assets

name: Load Fee (Mutual Funds)
expr: concept: sales charge paid when buying (front-end load) or selling (back-end load) mutual fund units

name: Efficient Frontier (concept)
expr: concept: set of optimal portfolios offering the highest expected return for each level of risk

name: Capital Allocation Line
expr: concept: line showing risk-return combinations from mixing a risk-free asset with a risky portfolio

name: Information Ratio
expr: IR = (Portfolio Return − Benchmark Return) / Tracking Error

name: Tracking Error
expr: Tracking Error = Standard Deviation of (Portfolio Return − Benchmark Return)

name: Active Return
expr: Active Return = Portfolio Return − Benchmark Return

name: Risk-Adjusted Return
expr: concept: investment return adjusted to reflect the amount of risk taken to achieve it

name: Rebalancing (Portfolio)
expr: concept: periodically adjusting portfolio weights back to their target allocation

name: Diversification Benefit
expr: concept: reduction in portfolio risk achieved by combining assets with less-than-perfect correlation

name: Systematic Withdrawal Plan (concept)
expr: concept: periodic, planned withdrawal of a fixed amount or percentage from an investment portfolio

name: Pro Forma Income Statement (concept)
expr: concept: forecasted income statement based on projected assumptions about sales and costs

name: Pro Forma Balance Sheet (concept)
expr: concept: forecasted balance sheet reflecting expected changes in assets, liabilities, and equity

name: Break-even Sales Growth Rate
expr: concept: minimum sales growth rate a firm needs to avoid requiring additional external financing

name: Financial Forecasting – Percent of Sales
expr: Projected Item = (Historical Item / Historical Sales) × Projected Sales

name: Variance Analysis (Budget vs Actual)
expr: Variance % = [(Actual − Budget) / Budget] × 100

name: Rolling Forecast (concept)
expr: concept: continuously updated financial forecast that extends the planning horizon as each period closes

name: Key Performance Indicator Tracking (Finance)
expr: concept: monitoring selected financial and operational metrics against targets over time

name: Credit Rating Scale (concept)
expr: concept: letter-grade system (e.g., AAA to D) indicating the creditworthiness of a borrower or debt instrument

name: Probability of Default
expr: concept: estimated likelihood that a borrower will fail to meet its debt obligations within a given time frame

name: Loss Given Default
expr: LGD = 1 − Recovery Rate

name: Expected Credit Loss
expr: ECL = Probability of Default × Loss Given Default × Exposure at Default

name: Corporate Governance (concept)
expr: concept: system of rules, practices, and processes by which a company is directed and controlled

name: Board Independence Ratio
expr: Board Independence = Number of Independent Directors / Total Board Members

name: Related Party Transaction Disclosure (concept)
expr: concept: reporting requirement for transactions between a company and parties with a pre-existing relationship

name: Direct Method (Cost Allocation)
expr: concept: allocating service department costs directly to production departments, ignoring inter-service usage

name: Step-Down Method (Cost Allocation)
expr: concept: allocating service department costs sequentially, allowing partial recognition of inter-service usage

name: Reciprocal Method (Cost Allocation)
expr: concept: allocating service department costs using simultaneous equations that fully recognize inter-service usage

name: Transfer Price (Cost-Based)
expr: Transfer Price = Variable Cost + Opportunity Cost per Unit

name: Transfer Price (Market-Based)
expr: concept: transfer price set equal to the prevailing external market price for the good or service

name: Negotiated Transfer Price (concept)
expr: concept: transfer price agreed upon through negotiation between the buying and selling divisions

name: Debt-to-Equity Ratio (Project Finance)
expr: D/E = Total Project Debt / Total Project Equity

name: Loan Life Coverage Ratio
expr: LLCR = PV of Cash Flow Available for Debt Service over Loan Life / Outstanding Debt

name: Project Internal Rate of Return
expr: concept: discount rate at which a project's cumulative discounted cash flows equal zero

name: Debt Service Reserve Account (concept)
expr: concept: reserve fund set aside to cover a set number of future debt service payments

name: Take-or-Pay Contract (concept)
expr: concept: agreement requiring a buyer to pay for a minimum quantity of goods whether or not delivery is taken

name: Pre-Money Valuation
expr: Pre-Money Valuation = Post-Money Valuation − Investment Amount

name: Post-Money Valuation
expr: Post-Money Valuation = Pre-Money Valuation + Investment Amount

name: Ownership Percentage (VC)
expr: Ownership % = Investment Amount / Post-Money Valuation

name: Internal Rate of Return (Private Equity Fund)
expr: concept: annualized rate of return earned on a fund's cash flows over its life

name: Multiple on Invested Capital
expr: MOIC = Total Value Returned / Total Capital Invested

name: Distributed to Paid-In Capital
expr: DPI = Cumulative Distributions / Cumulative Paid-In Capital

name: Residual Value to Paid-In Capital
expr: RVPI = Residual (Unrealized) Value / Cumulative Paid-In Capital

name: Total Value to Paid-In Capital
expr: TVPI = (Distributions + Residual Value) / Paid-In Capital

name: Vesting Schedule (concept)
expr: concept: timeline over which an employee earns full rights to granted equity or options

name: Liquidation Preference (concept)
expr: concept: right of preferred shareholders to be paid before common shareholders in a liquidation event

name: Net Trade Cycle
expr: Net Trade Cycle = DIO + DSO − DPO

name: Cash Operating Cycle (concept)
expr: concept: time taken to convert cash outflows for inventory into cash inflows from customers

name: Current Assets to Sales Ratio
expr: CA/Sales = Current Assets / Net Sales

name: Spontaneous Financing (concept)
expr: concept: short-term financing that arises automatically from normal business operations, such as trade payables

name: Letter of Credit – Sight vs Usance
expr: concept: a sight LC requires immediate payment on presentation of documents, a usance LC allows deferred payment

name: Bill of Exchange (concept)
expr: concept: a written unconditional order directing one party to pay a specified sum to another on demand or at a future date

name: Bank Guarantee (concept)
expr: concept: a bank's commitment to cover a loss if a client fails to fulfill a contractual obligation

name: Export Credit Insurance (concept)
expr: concept: insurance protecting exporters against the risk of non-payment by foreign buyers

name: Documentary Collection (concept)
expr: concept: trade payment method where banks act as intermediaries handling shipping documents on behalf of exporter/importer

name: Effective Tax Rate
expr: ETR = Total Tax Expense / Pre-Tax Income

name: Marginal Tax Rate (Corporate)
expr: concept: tax rate applied to the last unit of taxable income earned by a corporation

name: Tax Shield on Depreciation
expr: Tax Shield = Depreciation Expense × Tax Rate

name: Tax Shield on Interest
expr: Interest Tax Shield = Interest Expense × Tax Rate

name: Deferred Tax Liability (concept)
expr: concept: tax obligation arising from temporary differences between accounting and taxable income, payable in the future

name: Deferred Tax Asset (concept)
expr: concept: future tax benefit arising from temporary differences or carried-forward losses

name: Loan Amortization Schedule (concept)
expr: concept: table showing the breakdown of each loan payment into principal and interest over the loan term

name: Interest Portion of Payment n
expr: Interest(n) = Outstanding Balance(n−1) × Periodic Rate

name: Principal Portion of Payment n
expr: Principal(n) = EMI − Interest(n)

name: Total Interest Paid Over Loan Life
expr: Total Interest = (EMI × Number of Payments) − Principal Borrowed

name: Balloon Payment Loan (concept)
expr: concept: a loan structure with small regular payments and one large final payment

name: Convertible Bond (concept)
expr: concept: a bond that can be converted into a predetermined number of the issuer's equity shares

name: Conversion Ratio
expr: Conversion Ratio = Face Value of Bond / Conversion Price

name: Conversion Value
expr: Conversion Value = Conversion Ratio × Current Stock Price

name: Callable Bond (concept)
expr: concept: a bond that the issuer can redeem before maturity at a specified call price

name: Puttable Bond (concept)
expr: concept: a bond that allows the holder to demand early repayment before maturity

name: Floating Rate Note (concept)
expr: concept: a bond whose coupon rate is periodically reset based on a reference interest rate

name: Perpetual Bond (concept)
expr: concept: a bond with no maturity date that pays interest indefinitely

name: Bai Salam (concept)
expr: concept: a sale contract where full payment is made in advance for goods to be delivered at a future date

name: Istisna (concept)
expr: concept: a manufacturing/construction contract where payment can be made in installments as work progresses

name: Tawarruq (concept)
expr: concept: a monetization arrangement where an asset is bought on credit and resold for cash

name: Hawala (concept)
expr: concept: an informal value transfer system based on trust between a network of brokers

name: Tier 1 Capital Ratio
expr: Tier 1 Ratio = Tier 1 Capital / Risk-Weighted Assets

name: Liquidity Coverage Ratio
expr: LCR = High-Quality Liquid Assets / Total Net Cash Outflows over 30 Days

name: Net Stable Funding Ratio
expr: NSFR = Available Stable Funding / Required Stable Funding

name: Leverage Ratio (Basel)
expr: Leverage Ratio = Tier 1 Capital / Total Exposure

name: Risk-Weighted Assets (concept)
expr: concept: a bank's assets weighted according to their credit risk, used to determine capital requirements

name: Portfolio at Risk
expr: PAR = Outstanding Balance of Loans Overdue / Total Outstanding Loan Portfolio

name: Operational Self-Sufficiency
expr: OSS = Operating Income / (Financial Expense + Loan Loss Provision + Operating Expense)

name: Average Loan Size
expr: Average Loan Size = Total Loan Portfolio / Number of Active Borrowers

name: Client Outreach Ratio (concept)
expr: concept: measure of a microfinance institution's reach relative to the potential eligible population

name: Covered Call Payoff
expr: Payoff = Stock Payoff + Premium Received − Max(0, Spot − Strike)

name: Protective Put Payoff
expr: Payoff = Stock Payoff + Max(0, Strike − Spot) − Premium Paid

name: Straddle Strategy (concept)
expr: concept: simultaneously buying a call and a put at the same strike price to profit from large price moves in either direction

name: Bull Call Spread (concept)
expr: concept: buying a call at a lower strike and selling a call at a higher strike to profit from a moderate price rise

name: Bear Put Spread (concept)
expr: concept: buying a put at a higher strike and selling a put at a lower strike to profit from a moderate price fall

name: Iron Condor (concept)
expr: concept: an options strategy combining a bull put spread and a bear call spread to profit from low volatility

name: Working Capital Financing Policy – Aggressive
expr: concept: financing a larger share of current assets with short-term debt, higher risk and return

name: Working Capital Financing Policy – Conservative
expr: concept: financing a larger share of current assets with long-term funds, lower risk and return

name: Matching Principle (Working Capital)
expr: concept: financing permanent assets with long-term funds and temporary assets with short-term funds

name: Cost of Trade Credit
expr: Cost = [Discount% / (100 − Discount%)] × [365 / (Credit Period − Discount Period)]

name: Commitment Fee (Credit Line)
expr: concept: fee charged by a lender on the unused portion of an agreed credit facility

name: Factoring vs Forfaiting (concept)
expr: concept: factoring covers short-term domestic/export receivables, forfaiting covers medium/long-term export receivables without recourse

name: Bridge Financing (concept)
expr: concept: short-term financing used to cover a company's immediate needs until permanent financing is arranged

name: Mezzanine Financing (concept)
expr: concept: hybrid financing combining debt and equity features, typically subordinated to senior debt

name: Working Capital Gap
expr: Working Capital Gap = Current Assets − Current Liabilities (excluding bank borrowing)

name: Debtors Velocity
expr: Debtors Velocity = (Debtors × 365) / Net Credit Sales

name: Creditors Velocity
expr: Creditors Velocity = (Creditors × 365) / Net Credit Purchases

name: Stock Velocity (Inventory)
expr: Stock Velocity = (Average Inventory × 365) / Cost of Goods Sold

name: Operating Cash Flow Ratio
expr: OCF Ratio = Operating Cash Flow / Current Liabilities

name: Cash Flow to Debt Ratio
expr: CF to Debt = Operating Cash Flow / Total Debt

name: Quality of Earnings Ratio
expr: Quality of Earnings = Operating Cash Flow / Net Income

name: Sustainable Dividend Coverage
expr: Dividend Coverage = Net Income / Total Dividends

name: Interest Coverage (Cash Basis)
expr: Cash Interest Coverage = (EBIT + Depreciation) / Interest Expense

name: Capital Expenditure Ratio
expr: CapEx Ratio = Operating Cash Flow / Capital Expenditures

name: Free Cash Flow Yield
expr: FCF Yield = Free Cash Flow per Share / Market Price per Share

name: Return on Net Assets
expr: RONA = Net Income / (Fixed Assets + Working Capital)

name: Gross Working Capital Turnover
expr: GWC Turnover = Net Sales / Gross Working Capital

name: Net Profit to Net Worth Ratio
expr: NP to NW = Net Profit / Net Worth

name: Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio
expr: FCCR = (EBIT + Fixed Charges) / (Fixed Charges + Interest)

name: Overall Profitability Ratio
expr: OPR = Operating Profit / Capital Employed

name: Solvency Ratio
expr: Solvency Ratio = Total Assets / Total Liabilities

name: Current Assets to Total Assets Ratio
expr: CA/TA = Current Assets / Total Assets

name: Fixed Assets Ratio
expr: Fixed Assets Ratio = Fixed Assets / Long-term Funds

name: Working Capital to Sales Ratio
expr: WC/Sales = Net Working Capital / Net Sales

name: Inventory to Working Capital Ratio
expr: Inventory/WC = Inventory / Net Working Capital

name: Proprietary Funds Ratio
expr: Proprietary Funds Ratio = Shareholders' Funds / Total Tangible Assets

name: Return on Long-Term Funds
expr: ROLF = EBIT / (Long-term Debt + Equity)

name: Break-even Time (Product Development)
expr: concept: time from initial project investment until cumulative cash flows turn positive

name: Overhead Absorption Rate
expr: OAR = Budgeted Overheads / Budgeted Level of Activity

name: Contribution to Sales Ratio
expr: P/V Ratio = Contribution / Sales × 100

name: Multi-Product Break-even Point
expr: Composite BEP = Fixed Costs / Weighted Average Contribution Margin Ratio

name: Angle of Incidence (Break-even Chart)
expr: concept: the angle at which the total revenue line crosses the total cost line, indicating rate of profit growth

name: Key Factor / Limiting Factor Analysis
expr: concept: ranking products by contribution per unit of the scarcest resource to maximize profit

name: Make or Buy Decision (concept)
expr: concept: comparing the incremental cost of producing in-house versus purchasing from an outside supplier

name: Shut Down vs Continue Decision (concept)
expr: concept: comparing the contribution lost from shutting down against the fixed costs saved

name: Relevant Cost Analysis (concept)
expr: concept: analysis focusing only on future costs and revenues that differ between decision alternatives

name: Opportunity Cost in Decision Making
expr: concept: value of the best alternative forgone when a particular decision is made
